notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Nintendo Switch only (RAWG platforms), so steam=None. RAWG's first search result was the right entry (slug animal-crossing-2019). StrategyWiki has the guide under "Animal Crossing: New Horizons" at completion stage 2, marked as a stub, with 60 existing subpages: mostly item lists (clothing, furniture series and sets, DIY Recipes, Bugs, Fish, Sea Creatures, Fossils, Art), event pages (Bunny Day, Nature Day, May Day, International Museum Day, Wedding Season, Bug-Off, Fishing Tourney), Villagers, Special Visitors, Mystery Islands, Multiplayer, NookPhone, Camera, Passport titles, Gameplay and Controls. Its "Walkthrough" and "First Day" pages are linked from the contents but not written, nor are "Nook's Cranny", "Residential Services", "Island Evaluation", "Island Designer", "Nook Miles", "Happy Home Paradise" and its client pages; so the guide was not used as a walkthrough. Chapter names are grouped from the contents page names only (swNames); no text copied, and the order is a rough guess, as the game has no fixed story order. animalcrossing.fandom.com answers the API under "Animal Crossing: New Horizons" with about 144 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. "Happy Home Paradise" is named on both the StrategyWiki contents page and Fandom ("Animal Crossing: New Horizons - Happy Home Paradise"); whether it is paid was not checked.
